prerequisites: PCA course suitable prior to this course

learning_outcomes.text: Creation of the visualization and supervisory application in the Reliance system for various types of technological process models controlled by various PLC systems.

syllabus_topics: Basic characteristics of the SCADA systems
modules of the SCADA system Reliance
basic description of the design environment (stations manager, pictures manager, floating graphs manager,...)
Supervisory and visualization application creation for the technological process model controlled by a PLC(programmable logical controller)
